universe: 422 S&P 500 stocks a day, as the index was each day

A.name: Your system
A.rules: Last night's setups on the strongest sector, strongest stock list, highest score first; 2 at a time, each at most 30% of the account: a call by your rules when one fits (nearest 0.65 delta, else down to 0.15), else shares; sells on your exit (10 EMA under the 20 and price under the 50), a call also at -50% or 5 days before expiry, shares on an 8% stop. Calls priced with a model (no free history of option prices). Buys at the next open.

C.name: Your system, after 2 PM
C.rules: The same rules as Your system, but it buys at the next day's close, standing in for after 2 PM.

B.name: Claude's picks
B.rules: AI picks list: top relative strength, hold 10, keep while in the top 20, max 3 per sector, a tenth of the account each (a call by your rules when one fits, else shares); also sold on your exit.
